atAGlance: Sinh tố mãng cầu is soursop smoothie, tangy, creamy, fragrant, and one of the more exciting tropical fruit drinks for visitors.
whatItIs: Sinh tố mãng cầu is mãng cầu blended with ice, milk, or condensed milk. Expect soursop smoothie that is creamy, tropical, tart, and almost sherbet-like.
howToEnjoy: Ask for less sugar if you like the fruit’s natural tang.
howLocalsOrder: Sinh tố mãng cầu has natural tartness, so ask less sugar only if you enjoy a sharper fruit taste. Less ice makes the smoothie thicker and more fragrant.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Sinh tố mãng cầu introduces a fruit many visitors do not know before Vietnam: fragrant, soft, and sweet-sour.
goodToKnow: The texture can be thick and pulpy.
travelerCaution: Usually contains dairy or condensed milk.
